papers.title: When emotion meets conflict: Additive but not synergistic effects in neural oscillatory activity.
papers.reason: EEG evidence on fronto-central theta, centro-parietal alpha, and behavioural conflict adaptation directly informs models of cognitive control under emotional modulation.

papers.title: Aperiodic EEG activity is a domain-specific marker of attentional aging in neurotypical adults.
papers.reason: Longitudinal EEG and behavioural findings link aperiodic activity decline to sustained attention changes in aging, making it relevant to neural biomarkers of executive-attentional function.

papers.title: Generalized prefrontal task-progress sequences efficiently encode task structure
papers.reason: This animal mPFC study directly examines neural representations of sequential task progress during multi-stage decision behaviour, providing findings highly relevant to computational models of executive function.

papers.title: Altered brain-body activity during emotional mental imagery in major depressive disorder
papers.reason: The title indicates an affective neuroscience study of depression and emotional imagery rather than executive function modelling, neural mechanisms of planning or working memory, or digital cognitive biomarkers.
